```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, comment = NA)
options(knitr.kable.NA = "")
```

```{r}
hmc <- housepi::HouseholdModelClass$new("chain-binomial-heterogeneous")
hmc$template_param()

data("survey", package = "housepi")
survey$age_group <- survey$age > 15
survey$sus_group <- survey$age_group
survey$sus_group[(survey$age_group == 1) & (survey$sex == 1)] <- 2

hmc$add_group_rate("Infectivity", features = "age_group", prefix = "inf")
hmc$add_group_rate("Community_Susc", features = "sus_group", prefix = "com")
hmc$add_group_rate("Susceptibility", features = "sus_group", prefix = "sus")

hmc$infer(survey)
```
